description: Home Assistant REST API bridge for entity control, state polling, and network device discovery.
author: Charon Librarian

execution_iot_control.description: Controls a Home Assistant entity (switch, light, climate, relay, etc.) via REST API.

command.description: Service action to execute (e.g., 'turn_on', 'turn_off', 'toggle'). Defaults to 'turn_on'.

payload.description: Additional service parameters (brightness, color, temperature, etc.).

ha_url.description: Custom Home Assistant base URL (defaults to HOMEASSISTANT_URL env var).

ha_token.description: Long-lived access token (defaults to HOMEASSISTANT_TOKEN env var).

execution_iot_read.description: Queries state and attributes for a specific entity or reads full sensor network.

target_device.description: Target entity ID to query. If omitted, returns state discovery summary.

execution_iot_discover.description: Fetches all active entities and state objects registered in Home Assistant.
